reviews.title: Great Filtration, But Mold Appears Too Soon
reviews.body: The Brita Plus filters do a great job improving the taste and quality of my water. I can definitely tell a difference compared to tap water, and I like the peace of mind knowing they reduce more contaminants than the standard filters. Installation is easy, they fit perfectly in my pitcher, and the water flow stays strong for most of the filter’s life.However, I’ve consistently noticed that mold starts developing before the 2-month mark, even with proper care and regular cleaning of the pitcher. I follow the recommended maintenance steps and keep everything clean, so it’s frustrating to see buildup appear sooner than expected. It doesn’t affect performance immediately, but it does make me uncomfortable continuing to use the filter as long as advertised.Overall, these filters work well and deliver clean-tasting water, but the early mold issue keeps them from being perfect. If Brita could improve that aspect, these would easily be a 5-star product.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 13 January 2026
reviews.author: Trent L.

features: TRAPS 2X MORE CONTAMINANTS: The BritaPlus high density water filter traps twice as many contaminants as the Brita Standard Filter; packaging may vary
GREAT TASTE, LESS WASTE: This replacement filter improves water taste and odor by reducing chlorine, so you can get great tasting filtered water without the waste of single use plastic bottles
FROM THE BRAND: Put your trust in a filter from the number one brand in water filtration; for at home or on the go, Brita delivers great tasting filtered water
CHANGE EVERY 2 MONTHS: Approximate timing based on 40 gallon filter life and average family usage of 11 glasses per day; works in all Brita systems except Stream
DITCH PLASTIC BOTTLES FOR GOOD: Just one Brita filter can replace up to 300 plastic bottles; that makes 1,800 bottles replaced per year when you switch to Brita
